title: TCG:OAL-B3

objectives.text:
Choose two hero cards from you deck. 
 Put a Spirit Jar into zone 3 and another into zone 4 with 1 of those heroes face up under each. 
 If a lead hero moves into zone 5 while there are no Spirit Jars in play, you win.
